player_prompt.intro: Kuna wasa da Mastermind. Kuna buƙatar nemo lambar da take {code_length} lambobi masu tsawo, kowane lamba daga 1 zuwa {num_numbers}, {repeats}. A cikin amsarku, zaku iya ƙaddamar da tunaninku a cikin tsari mai zuwa: '[2 1 4 5]'. Bayan kowane zato, zaku sami ra'ayoyi a cikin nau'i na baƙar fata da fari. A baki yana nuna lambar daidai a cikin matsayi mai kyau, yayin da fararen peg yana nuna lambar daidai a cikin matsayi mara kyau. Kuna da {max_turns} ya juya don gane lambar.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ba ka amsa da jerin lambobi da aka raba ta da sarari ba.
invalid_move.not_integers: Dukkanin shigarwar dole ne su zama lambobi masu inganci.
invalid_move.wrong_length: A tsammani ya kamata ya ƙunshi daidai {code_length} lambobi.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Duk lambobi dole ne su kasance tsakanin 1 da {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Ba a yarda da lambobi biyu ba.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Kun riga kun yi tsammani {guess}. Da fatan za a gwada wani zato.

game_action.feedback: An gabatar da [{guess}]. Sakamako: {black_pegs} tsumba baƙi, {white_pegs} tsumba fari.

outcome.win: Ka warware lambar, warware {black_pegs} daga {code_length} ƙuƙwalwa daidai
outcome.turn_limit: An kai iyakar juyawa. Ka yi tsammani kashi {percent} na lambobin daidai.
